title: Supplementary methods, figures, and summary tables
description: Supplementary methods, supplemental figure legends, concise summary tables, and Genome Biology-oriented reproducibility notes.

title: Dataset manifest and analysis summary
description: One row per analyzed dataset, including sample labels, Space Ranger version/source URL, number of spots and genes, ExperimentHub metadata when available, percentage of genes favoring nonstationary covariance, and stationary/non-spatial summaries.

title: Per-gene Bayes factor and category summary
description: One row per analyzed gene and dataset, including log Bayes factors, Bayes factor evidence strengths, model favored by the nonstationary-versus-stationary comparison, stationary-versus-non-spatial comparison when available, and the final three-model category.

title: Evidence-strength counts for nonstationary versus stationary models
description: Counts and percentages of genes by dataset, favored model, and Bayes factor evidence strength for the nonstationary versus stationary comparison.

title: Stationary spatial versus stationary non-spatial summary
description: Counts and percentages of stationary-favored genes that favor either the stationary spatial model or the stationary non-spatial model.

title: clusterProfiler GSEA results
description: Full GO biological process and KEGG GSEA output from clusterProfiler, with genes ranked by log Bayes factor.

title: MSigDB fgsea stationarity enrichment results
description: Full Hallmark, KEGG, Reactome, and GO biological process fgsea output from MSigDB gene sets, with genes ranked by log Bayes factor.

title: Simulation FDR and power curves
description: Aggregated threshold-specific false discovery rate and average power for the two simulation settings.

title: Simulation replicate summaries
description: Per-replicate FDR and power at the Bayes factor threshold c = 1 for the two simulation settings.

title: Software and reproducibility manifest
description: List of analysis scripts, their role in the workflow, file sizes, and MD5 checksums.
